## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve Oparax's real product model and content: an AI news desk that monitors tracked X sources, identifies on-beat stories, drafts in the reporter's voice, exposes council provenance, and lets the reporter post to X.
- Use the existing Next.js, React, Tailwind v4, shadcn, Radix, and vendored AI Elements stack; prefer shadcn for general UI, AI Elements for AI-specific states, 21st.dev for concrete gaps, and custom components last.
- Render a rich black-to-grey-to-white spectrum with predominantly light text on dark surfaces and a deliberate blue accent or blue surface; exact values remain open for comparison.
- Use sentence-case interface copy and headings. Preserve proper nouns and acronyms such as X, AI, and Slack.
- Use rounded-rectangular controls rather than pill-shaped primary buttons.
- Make active AI or LLM work legible with restrained motion and shimmer, while respecting reduced-motion preferences.
- Keep accessibility, keyboard operation, responsive behavior, and realistic production content fixed across every direction.
- For comparable exploration, every direction must include a component board, an AI-state board, and the same realistic Oparax Feed content.
- Synthesize the researched strengths of Linear hierarchy and density, Vercel precision, Devin AI transparency, and Hootsuite source-to-publish workflow semantics; do not superficially clone any one product.

### Avoid

- Do not treat the current app/globals.css colors, Hanken Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, current spacing, density, radii, elevation, component styling, or page composition as a visual baseline; they are implementation inventory only during exploration.
- No uppercase Tailwind utility, text-transform uppercase, or ordinary all-caps user-facing copy.
- No eyebrow or kicker label stacked above a title, and no redundant split heading treatment.
- No color-only variants: directions must differ meaningfully in hierarchy, density, composition, navigation, content emphasis, or interaction model.
- No decorative motion that obscures state, competes with content, or ignores reduced-motion preferences.
- No invented product features, dormant capabilities, fake metrics, or generic dashboard content replacing the real Oparax workflow.

## Decisions

- **visual-discovery-not-restyle**: This phase is visual-system discovery, not a redesign constrained by the current production styling. (Owner design-system synthesis checkpoint)
- **open-exploration-axes**: Typography, exact palette, spacing, density, radii, elevation, component styling, page composition, navigation treatment, and source-versus-draft layout remain deliberately open exploration axes. (Owner design-system synthesis checkpoint)
- **function-not-visual-form**: The current Oparax UI contributes product function, information architecture, states, and realistic content only; it does not contribute visual form. (Owner design-system synthesis checkpoint)
- **compare-three-directions**: Three coherent directions will be compared before selecting or merging a winner; abandoned directions do not become production decisions. (Owner design-system synthesis checkpoint)
- **winner-extension-order**: After a winner is selected, extend it to extraction, create-agent, and mobile before distilling the final detailed design document. (Owner design-system synthesis checkpoint)
